Name: Hoshea, Son of Azaziah
Summary: Son of Azaziah, ruler of the children of Ephraim.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 27:20: Son of Azaziah, ruler of the children of Ephraim.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Hoshea stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
